conflicts.where: Lessons 5, 6 and 7 compared with Lessons 3, 4 and 8 (maize price dataset)
conflicts.problem: The lessons give the same 40 Wakulima prices incompatible values. Lessons 3, 4 and 8 use KSh 98 to 120 (98, 105, 112, 120 with frequencies 16, 12, 8, 4). Lesson 5 puts the modal class at KSh 100-109 with a tail to 140-149. Lesson 6 gives the modal class as Ksh 50-59, and Lesson 7 uses class intervals of width 5 with an assumed mean of 72 and a mean of about 72.7, a median of about 73.2 and a modal class midpoint of 72. These cannot all describe one dataset, so no Final Explanation can agree with every lesson.

Lesson 8 states the median is about KSh 103, but the Lesson 4 table cannot give this. The 20th and 21st ordered values are both KSh 105 (cumulative frequency 16 at 98, 28 at 105), so the median is KSh 105. KSh 103 is not even a value in the table.
